desc:
🚘 Welcome to +1 Limo Escape! 🚘

HOW TO PLAY:
⚡ Every level adds +1 car to your limo. How LONG can you go?
🛣️ Drive your limo across 2 worlds and 15+ sky stages and stop on the GOLD PADS to earn wins!
⛽ Watch your fuel! Level up to fill your tank and drive even further.
🏋️ Train on treadmills to level up faster, and pop boost bubbles for extra XP!
🏎️ Spend your wins on better limos: Wedding Limo, Party Bus, Fire Truck, Jet Limo and more!
🚀 Keep driving forward, but one wrong turn could send your whole limo off the edge! 😱

👍 Like the game and join the group for a FREE gift!
